hi Jennifer,

Sorry about that. We are working on `nimbleHMC` to prepare for release and that broke some things, because we had failed to have the installation instructions refer to a fixed commit on GitHub.

We've updated the instructions at r-nimble.org/ad-beta to indicate that when you install `nimbleHMC` you should include `ref="AD-rc1"`

-chris

I've also tried using the no multi-architecture argument:

install_github("nimble-dev/nimbleHMC", subdir = "nimbleHMC", INSTALL_opts=c("--no-multiarch"))
